design.service: aquaponic fish tanks, 60 kg standing stock
design.ammonia_load: fish excrete NH3/NH4+ through the gills: ~30 g NH4+-N per kg feed (protein metabolism); toxic above 1 mg/L un-ionised NH3
design.O2_demand: dissolved O2 for fish respiration: ~5 mg/L minimum (aeration required); the air stones are the O2 source
design.notes_extra: the fish are the ammonia SOURCE and the O2 SINK of the aquaponic loop; the biofilter bacteria are the ammonia CONSUMER and the O2 SINK

nozzles.service: ammonia-rich fish waste water (NH3/NH4+ from the gills)
fish sludge to the larvae bin
fish harvest to the food store
loop top-up: root-zone growth water and evaporation
polished loop water return (2.2 kg/d duckweed growth drawn from the loop)

material: HDPE tank body with a food-grade LDPE aquaculture liner, SS316 hardware above the waterline, CPVC loop fittings
holds: no AQS-PLAN-006 section 4 route class for class fish_tank
